title: Worktrees now close with their task: disk 8.4 GB → 2.5 GB

owner_note.text: 22 stuck worktrees were closed: leftovers committed to their own branches, folders removed, branches kept (manifest: ai/sessions/worktree-removals.jsonl). 17 branches hold commits not on michael/dev; they are listed in ai/sessions/ready-to-merge.jsonl (mostly logs, a few real files). From now on on-landing and Servex's 10-minute tick close a worktree when its task lands or after 48 quiet hours. The pool failed because qf-1 and qf-5 were left "locked initializing" by a crashed worktree add 10 days ago; Pool.js now unlocks those, which takes effect after the next Servex restart (qf-1/5/9 free up then). Docs: Server/doc/worktrees.md.
